title: TimelineEntry
description: A single precessional-age (or framing) entry in the project's timeline. Returned by /v1/timeline/{slug}/.

symbol.description: Zodiac glyph or other emoji marker.

color.description: Palette key from the Bifrost theme.

start_year.description: Year of the age's start (negative for BCE), as string to allow non-numeric prefixes like 'before -21810'.

genesis_day.description: Which day of the Genesis 1 creation account this age aligns with (0 if N/A).

claims.description: Inline claim markers in the body: the assertions the page labels, each with its epistemic label and, where one controls it, the core claim record. The same spans appear in body_html as <span class="claim" data-claim-type data-claim-id>.

text.description: The labelled assertion as plain text.
